versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

- Initial release of daycare-waitlist-status-board skill.
- Organizes scattered daycare waitlist information into a structured comparison board.
- Focuses on privacy-conscious tracking, omitting sensitive child details from shared outputs.
- Includes licensing and policy verification, provider-specific questions, and decision checklists.
- Provides polite follow-up message templates for different stages of the waitlist process.
- Emphasizes user priorities and official verification, not judgment of provider safety or quality.
